async def act(page):
    # Step 1: Click the 'Issues' link in the Project navigation to go to the issues list page
    # Use .first to avoid strict mode violation as there are two links with name 'Issues'
    issues_link = page.get_by_role("complementary", name="Project navigation").get_by_role("link", name="Issues").first
    await issues_link.click()
    await page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")
    
    # Step 2: On the issues list page, click the 'New issue' button to create a new issue
    new_issue_button = page.get_by_role("link", name="New issue")
    await new_issue_button.click()
    await page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")
    
    # Step 3: Fill in the title field with the specified text
    title_field = page.get_by_role("textbox", name="Title (required)")
    await title_field.fill("Plans for adding Python 3.11 related resources")
    
    # Step 4: Fill in the description field with the specified text
    description_field = page.get_by_role("textbox", name="Description")
    await description_field.fill("Hello, I would like to ask about your plans for adding resources related to Python 3.11 in this awesome-python repository. Are there any updates or timelines for this?")
    
    # Step 5: Submit the issue by clicking the submit button
    submit_button = page.get_by_role("button", name="Submit issue")
    await submit_button.click()
    await page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")
    
    # No further actions needed
    return "Issue created successfully"
